title: A landing page
summary: One web page for one purpose, built from your brand kit and your own pictures.

asks.label: Which pictures, by name, from your files?
Which company file holds the facts?
What should a visitor do? A link or an email address:

takes.label: Make a landing page that learns from this

text: Make one landing page for this: [subject]. Build it as a static site of HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, from the brand kit and the site kit only: no package, and nothing fetched from anywhere. Copy these pictures from the company's files into the site: [pictures]. Take every fact from the company's files and invent none; read this one first: [facts]. Give a visitor one clear thing to do, with this link or email address when I give one: [action]. Look at every version through the page viewer at phone and desktop width and fix what it shows, at most three times, before you report. Nothing is published; the owner picks a version. If I name research notes here, learn from their layout and examples and copy none of them: [research]
